title: Gotify

tagline.en: Self-hosted push notifications: send messages with a simple REST API and receive them in the browser or the Android app
tagline.es: Notificaciones push autoalojadas: envía mensajes con una API REST sencilla y recíbelos en el navegador o en la app de Android
tagline.de: Selbst gehostete Push-Benachrichtigungen: Nachrichten über eine einfache REST-API senden und im Browser oder in der Android-App empfangen
tagline.fr: Notifications push auto-hébergées : envoyez des messages avec une API REST simple et recevez-les dans le navigateur ou l'app Android
tagline.pt: Notificações push auto-hospedadas: envie mensagens com uma API REST simples e receba-as no navegador ou no app Android
tagline.ja: セルフホスト型プッシュ通知：シンプルな REST API でメッセージを送信し、ブラウザや Android アプリで受信
tagline.ru: Собственные push-уведомления: отправляйте сообщения через простой REST API и получайте их в браузере или в приложении для Android
tagline.hi: सेल्फ-होस्टेड पुश नोटिफ़िकेशन: आसान REST API से संदेश भेजें और उन्हें ब्राउज़र या Android ऐप में पाएं

notes: Gotify creates the administrator on the first start, while the database has no users, from GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_NAME (admin) and GOTIFY_DEFAULTUSER_PASS (a generated password shown on the first-run card) instead of the upstream default admin / admin. Later changes to these variables do nothing: change the password in the web interface (Users).

One container with one named volume on /app/data, where the image keeps everything by default: the SQLite database (gotify.db), uploaded application images and plugins. Gotify also supports MySQL and PostgreSQL, which a single notification server rarely needs.

To send a message: create an application in the web interface, then POST https://<your domain>/message with its token (header X-Gotify-Key or ?token=) and a title, message and priority. Clients (the web interface, the Android app, CLI) receive messages over a WebSocket stream, which the panel's proxy passes through.

GOTIFY_SERVER_SECURECOOKIE marks the session cookie Secure, since the site is served over HTTPS. Public registration stays off (GOTIFY_REGISTRATION=false, the upstream default): the administrator creates users.
Gotify needs very little memory: the 128m floor is the starting point.
